theme:ai-power.value: 2026-10-31 Missed earlier in the week: Vertiv's Q3 (Oct 28) sales rose 61% to about $4.3 billion, organic orders grew more than 100%, and it raised its 2026 guidance on every key metric (company release); VRT rose 16.48% that day. It gave back 5.46% on Oct 30 to 232.50 but still rose 19.65% for the week, while GEV rose 5.26% to 857.87 (Massive). The money keeps flowing to cooling and power gear even as the spenders are sold.
theme:ai-power.was: 2026-10-30 Correction: Microsoft cut its capex forecast for the year to $170 billion from $175 billion, and both Microsoft and Alphabet capex fell short of estimates (CNBC, Oct 29); an earlier entry read the $170 billion as a 2027 increase. Amazon said it will spend 'meaningfully more' in 2027 (CNBC). The ECB's Lagarde said hyperscaler bond issuance is helping push long term borrowing costs up worldwide (CNBC).

theme:robotics-automation.value: 2026-10-30 North American robot orders rose 25% in Q3 2026, and collaborative robots reached 1,831 units worth $63.8 million, up about 56% in units from a year earlier (Metrology News, Oct 30).
theme:robotics-automation.was: 2026-10-29 ARK bought Teradyne in ARKK, ARKQ and ARKX on Oct 28, about 0.25% of each fund (ARK email). AGCO is running Agility Robotics humanoids at its Hesston, Kansas plant, and Schaeffler has humanoids building actuator parts for other humanoids in China (engineering.com, Oct 28).

theme:critical-materials.value: 2026-10-30 Rio Tinto said it has begun restarting underground operations at its Oyu Tolgoi copper mine in Mongolia after a seismic event halted mining (Reuters, Oct 30).
theme:critical-materials.was: 2026-10-29 Lynas lifted first quarter revenue 55% to A$310.1 million on record realised prices of A$102.1 per kg, with floor price contracts covering over half its sales, but flagged shutdowns at its Malaysia and Kalgoorlie plants (IndexBox, Oct 29). Lula's win keeps Brazil's push to refine its own rare earths; Brazil holds the second largest reserves, but Benchmark sees no domestic refining until 2030 (Benchmark Mineral Intelligence, Oct 28).

theme:defense-reshoring.value: 2026-10-31 The US approved a $2.1 billion Patriot missile sale to Ukraine on Oct 30 (Reuters). L3Harris reported a record $53.2 billion backlog after $19.3 billion of Q3 orders, including seven year contracts of $6.3 billion for THAAD propulsion and $4.7 billion for PAC-3 MSE propulsion (Defence Industry Europe, Oct 30). For the week LHX rose 9.31%, GD 6.65% and LMT 5.42% (Massive).
theme:defense-reshoring.was: 2026-10-30 Boeing bounced 3.30% to 172.65 on Oct 29 on 16.76 million shares, about twice its normal volume (Massive), as dip buyers stepped in after two heavy selling days (TradingKey). Defense primes rose the same day: GD 4.65% to 370.82, LMT 2.20% and NOC 1.73% (Massive).

theme:space-quantum-cyber.value: 2026-10-29 Fortinet fell 25.7% premarket on Oct 29 after its Q3: results beat, but product growth of 37% missed the roughly 50% the market wanted and it cut its service revenue guide to $5.15 billion to $5.17 billion; BofA downgraded it to Neutral with a $140 target, and an unconfirmed breach report added pressure (Investing.com). Palo Alto, Zscaler and CrowdStrike fell in sympathy.
theme:space-quantum-cyber.was: 2026-10-24 Cybersecurity bounced back from last week's downgrade sell off: on Oct 23 CRWD rose 8.2% to 257.57 and PANW 7.2% to 380.55 (dashboard), after Deutsche Bank named Palo Alto one of three companies placed to gain from rising AI use and a newly found software flaw that could affect a large share of websites put defense spending back in focus (Motley Fool, Oct 23). CRWD is up about 13% from its Oct 16 close of 227.39.

theme:healthcare-medtech.value: 2026-10-31 An FDA advisory committee met Oct 30 on Sydnexis's SYD-101, a low dose atropine drop for childhood myopia. There was no vote, and members broadly backed the FDA's concerns about its single Phase III trial and the literature (Pink Sheet, BioWorld). WST held its breakout on Oct 30, closing at 412.62 above the 398.67 pivot, but fell 0.97% on 1.81 times normal volume (Massive).
theme:healthcare-medtech.was: 2026-10-30 Dexcom's Q3 revenue rose 11% to $1.3445 billion and it raised its 2026 revenue guide to $5.20 billion to $5.25 billion, with higher margin guidance (company release, Oct 29). AstraZeneca beat with $16.2 billion of Q3 revenue and core EPS of $2.79 against $2.59 expected (CNBC, Oct 30). The FDA panel on Sydnexis's SYD-101 child myopia drop meets Oct 30.

theme:ai-compute.value: 2026-10-31 Intel closed down 28.6% at 65.76 on Oct 30, its worst day since the 1970s, after guiding Q4 to $15 billion to $16 billion and flagging an explosion at its Israel plant worth about $600 million of revenue over two quarters (CNBC, Barchart, Massive). The Nasdaq fell 2.86% that day and the Nasdaq 100 about 6.5% in October, its worst month since March 2025. MRVL fell 10.05% to 196.40, below its buy zone, and LITE 8.57% to 840.70 with no deal announced (Massive). Amazon arranged up to $80 billion of supplier financing for its AI build (Barchart).
theme:ai-compute.was: 2026-10-30 Amazon kept its $220 billion 2026 capex plan, spent $77.3 billion in Q3 against $58.7 billion expected, and said it will spend 'meaningfully more' in 2027; AWS grew 39% but trailing free cash flow was negative $42.4 billion, and the stock was down 6% to 7% premarket (CNBC). Intel guided Q4 revenue to $15 billion to $16 billion against $17.1 billion expected and was down about 24% premarket. Marvell closed down 13.24% at 218.34 on reports of an all stock Lumentum deal (Massive, Motley Fool).

theme:glp1-obesity.value: 2026-10-31 Lilly closed at a record 1,417.54 on Oct 30, up 11.31% for the week after its Q3 beat and raise (Massive). ARK sold 17,626 LLY shares in ARKK the same day, about 0.39% of the fund (ARK email).
theme:glp1-obesity.was: 2026-10-30 WST confirmed its swing breakout on Oct 29: it closed at 416.67, above the 398.67 pivot, on 1,873,146 shares, 3.35 times its 50 day average, the day after its beat and raise (Massive). It traded as high as 438.27 before fading under its 420.69 open.

theme:fintech-crypto-rails.value: 2026-10-31 Analysts blame North Korea's TraderTraitor unit for the $6.3 billion Binance hack, most of which left Binance wallets in about 20 minutes; Binance reserved over $6.3 billion to cover losses and plans a proof of reserves report by Monday (BBC). COIN fell 12.72% for the week to 143.54, HOOD 10.6% to 84.99 and CRCL 15.6% to 72.54 (Massive), while ARK bought all three on Oct 30 (ARK email).
theme:fintech-crypto-rails.was: 2026-10-30 Binance said a security breach had an estimated $6.3 billion impact, with about $3 billion frozen, and pledged to cover losses; Circle and Tether froze a combined $2.54 billion, and bitcoin fell below $78,000 (CNBC, Oct 30). Mastercard rose 4.16% to 635.70 and Visa 2.48% to 410.54 on Oct 29 after Mastercard's Q3 beat (Massive, briefs.co).

industry:agriculture-food.value: 2026-10-29 Rechecked on the daily rotation. AGCO's Q3 (Oct 29) sales fell 8.6% to $2.26 billion, with Latin America down 19.1% and Brazil tractor retail sales down 17% for nine months; it kept its 2026 outlook and targets $2 billion of PTx retrofit sales by 2029 from about $1 billion this year. About 29% of global urea trade normally passes Hormuz (S&P Global), which keeps the cost case for nitrogen-fixing biologicals alive. No stage moves: the PRRS pig still waits on Mexico and Japan, and Corteva reports Nov 11.
industry:agriculture-food.was: 2026-10-17 Rechecked on the daily rotation. Deere announced next generation perception autonomy kits in early October for tractors and tillage, orchard sprayers, and landscape and construction machines, and AGCO's Oct 6 Tech Day showed PTx retrofit autonomy for mixed fleets. Corteva set its first crop protection only report for Nov 11 after the close. Perfect Day now targets first commercial whey deliveries from India in Q1 2027. No stage moves: these are product launches, not new revenue.

industry:communications.value: 2026-10-24 On Oct 23 reports said SpaceX is seeking cell tower sites for a mobile carrier service, building on its roughly $8 billion purchase of 800 MHz spectrum from Grain Management earlier in October. Crown Castle rose about 9% to 85.97 and American Tower about 4% to 188.97, while AT&T fell 8.0% to 20.93 on 2.4 times normal volume and T-Mobile 7.7% to 146.54 (Motley Fool midday, Oct 23; dashboard and Yahoo Finance closes).
industry:communications.was: 2026-10-16 Rechecked on the daily rotation. Ericsson's Q3 (Oct 15) showed sales of SEK 59.5 billion against 56.2 billion a year ago, 7% organic growth led by Networks, and net income down to about SEK 5.8 billion because last year included a divestment gain. It still sees a flat radio market in 2026 and rising AI driven component costs. The ERIC ADR jumped 11.8% to 10.71 on about 4.5 times normal volume. Amazon had almost 400 Leo satellites up as of Oct 9; AST has not yet dated its next launch.

industry:consumer.value: 2026-10-30 Rotation recheck. EssilorLuxottica's Q3 wearables revenue was 486 million euros, up 20% but a sharp slowdown in smart glasses growth (Reuters, Oct 20). Dexcom's Q3 revenue rose 11% to $1.3445 billion and it raised its 2026 guide to $5.20 billion to $5.25 billion (Oct 29). The FDA panel on SYD-101 meets Oct 30 with FDA doubts on the data (Pink Sheet). Oura still has no IPO date. No stage moves.
industry:consumer.was: 2026-10-18 Rechecked on the daily rotation. Dexcom set Q3 results for Oct 29 after the close and Hims for Nov 9; Abbott reports Oct 21. The FDA panel on Sydnexis's SYD-101 myopia drop is still set for Oct 30, and Oura has not set a new IPO date since postponing on Sep 29. No stage moves: these are dates, not new revenue or approvals.

industry:defense-security.value: 2026-10-31 Rechecked on the daily rotation. Missile defense production money keeps growing on multiyear terms: L3Harris got seven year contracts of $6.3 billion for THAAD propulsion and $4.7 billion for PAC-3 MSE propulsion, holds a record $53.2 billion backlog and opened a new solid rocket motor plant in Arkansas; it also booked more than $500 million of VAMPIRE counter drone orders (Defence Industry Europe, Oct 30). The US approved a $2.1 billion Patriot sale to Ukraine (Reuters, Oct 30). No stage moves: this is production money for fielded interceptors, while hypersonics and space based defense still wait on tests and the full year budget.
industry:defense-security.was: 2026-10-19 Rechecked on the daily rotation. Drone Dominance Gauntlet II orders have started (Neros 14,000 drones for over $100 million, Swarm Defense 4,000 for at least $25 million), the Army now expects its first LOCUST X3 laser by Q4 FY2027 and combat use by early 2028, and the Senate leader signaled no new Golden Dome reconciliation money before the midterms. No stage moves: orders are small next to the 60,000 drone plan.

industry:energy.value: 2026-10-23 Bloom Energy's Q3 (Oct 22) showed behind the meter power is selling: product revenue crossed $1 billion for the first time ($1.07 billion, up 179%), total revenue rose 138% to $1.24 billion, and 2026 revenue guidance rose to $4.4 to $4.6 billion. The catch is cash: the quarter used $181 million of free cash flow as inventory and receivables grew.
industry:energy.was: 2026-10-20 Rechecked on the daily rotation. Behind the meter power keeps adding real orders: LS Electric booked $138.5 million of switchgear for Bloom fuel cells at a Pennsylvania data center, likely Aligned's Project Phoenix where Bloom may supply up to 2 GW (DCD). Fervo's Cape Station is running and it is hosting an investor open house, while JPMorgan cut its target to $27 on Oct 19. Small reactor stocks hit new lows on a Barclays downgrade of NuScale (Oct 20). No stage moves.

industry:financials.value: 2026-10-27 SoFi launched SOFIE on Oct 22, which it calls the first national bank issued tokenized deposit for consumers: each token is $1 on deposit at SoFi Bank, FDIC insured, paying 4.40% APY, and can be converted 1:1 into its SoFiUSD stablecoin, which ends the yield and the insurance (SoFi, The Block). Rollout to its crypto customers finishes in November.
industry:financials.was: 2026-10-24 The OCC finalized its GENIUS Act stablecoin rule on Oct 21, 2026, the first agency to finish its part, setting federal standards for licensing, reserves, redemptions, audits and custody ahead of the law's Jan 18, 2027 start. Existing issuers that file a complete application in time can get waivers of up to 12 months, but no application window is open until OMB approves the forms. Rechecked on the daily rotation: Upstart confirmed Q3 results for Nov 3, and DTCC's October tokenization launch is not yet confirmed.

industry:healthcare.value: 2026-10-29 Lilly's Q3 revenue rose 39% to $24.4 billion, driven by Mounjaro and Zepbound, and it raised 2026 revenue guidance to $91 billion to $92 billion from $85 billion to $87 billion, its third raise this year (company release, Quartz). West Pharmaceutical, which supplies pen and vial components, also beat and raised.
industry:healthcare.was: 2026-10-21 Rechecked on the daily rotation. Intuitive's Q3 (Oct 20) showed revenue of $3.05 billion, up 22%, and about 14% da Vinci procedure growth, but US procedures grew only 10% against 20% abroad. It plans extended use instruments and other price moves that cut instrument revenue per case 3% to 5% by the end of 2027, and took a $450 million antitrust settlement charge. The stock traded near $406 after hours from 438.00. Gene editing (lonvo-z decision March 10, 2027), AI diagnostics (Medicare fee schedule final rule due early November) and brain implants had no new milestone; no FDA action on CagriSema has been reported.

industry:industrials.value: 2026-10-26 Tesla said on its Oct 21 call that early Optimus production has started on a Fremont line built for about 1 million robots a year, that reaching about 20,000 a week will take at least a year, and that it plans to sell to outside companies around the end of 2027, with its AI5 chip in Optimus around April 2027. Stage stays pilot: output is for internal use and there are no outside orders yet.
industry:industrials.was: 2026-10-13 Symbotic announced on Oct 13 that it is buying cellumation, a Bremen sortation company whose software driven floor replaces fixed conveyors. At the same time a Wall Street Journal report says Walmart's warehouse automation keeps hitting breakdowns and that Symbotic does not expect a workable in store pickup model until 2028, which pushes out the 400 store option.

industry:materials.value: 2026-10-27 Rechecked on the daily rotation. Hexcel reported Q3 on Oct 21: sales about $496 million, up 8.8%, adjusted EPS $0.50 against $0.37, commercial aerospace up about 21% and defense and space down about 9%. It kept 2026 guidance, but shares fell about 11% to 12% as sales missed the roughly $502 million forecast (SEC filing, Investing.com).
industry:materials.was: 2026-10-14 Rechecked on the daily rotation. Hexcel confirmed it will report Q3 results on Oct 21 after the close, with the call Oct 22; third party calendars showing Oct 26 or Oct 28 are wrong. MP Materials still guides first commercial magnet shipments to GM for Q4 2026, with no shipment date announced.

industry:space.value: 2026-10-28 Rechecked on the daily rotation. SpaceX's Q3 2026 report (Oct 20) showed revenue of $14.6 billion, up 161%, and net income of $4.4 billion, and called Flight 14 its first revenue generating Starship mission; but its rocket business lost $7 million in the quarter and $1.21 billion in nine months, so Starlink and AI carry the profit. SpaceX says Flight 15 will try to catch both the booster and the ship; no date is confirmed. Rocket Lab pushed Neutron's first launch to 2027 on Oct 14 over tank defects (Reuters). RKLB closed up 8.34% at 58.31 on Oct 27 (Massive).
industry:space.was: 2026-10-15 Rechecked on the daily rotation. Starship Flight 14 (Sep 28) was the first to reach orbit and deployed all 26 Starlink V3 satellites, though a vacuum engine failed and the stay in orbit was cut short; Flight 15 is penciled for no earlier than Oct 19 but not confirmed. SpaceX was reported Oct 6 to 7 to be seeking about $40 billion of debt to buy Nvidia chips. Planet Labs stock is down about 66% from its May peak even with record revenue, as money rotates to SpaceX and rates rise.

industry:technology.value: 2026-10-29 Marvell is in advanced talks to buy Lumentum, a maker of lasers for data center optics, with a deal possibly announced next week (Reuters, Oct 28). If it closes, a major chip designer would own a key laser supplier for optical links, including co-packaged optics. MRVL fell over 11% and LITE rose over 6% premarket Oct 29 (TradingKey). The stage does not change: this is a deal, not new revenue.
industry:technology.was: 2026-10-22 Meta narrowed 2026 capex to $135 to $145 billion but gave no 2027 number and had about negative $2.1 billion of free cash flow in Q3 (Oct 21). The inference build is still growing, but the biggest buyer now spends more than it earns, so 2027 budgets are the test.

industry:transportation.value: 2026-10-23 Rechecked on the daily rotation. On its Oct 21 call Tesla said its Austin Cybercab fleet grew about 10 times since the early September launch, neared 2 million cumulative unsupervised miles, and should reach Dallas next month, with first customer Cybercab deliveries targeted by end of 2026. It also cut 2026 capex to about $20 billion. The FAA drone rule (Part 108) is still at White House review past its Oct 8 window, and neither Joby nor Archer has confirmed a paying passenger.
industry:transportation.was: 2026-10-12 Waymo closed a $5 billion term loan, upsized from about $3 billion and priced at 5.25 points over the benchmark rate, to expand its fleet in the US and abroad. Lenders funding robotaxis is a sign the business is moving from research to fleet operations.

country:argentina.value: 2026-10-30 The Merval fell 1% to 94,530 on Oct 29, a fourth straight loss, while dollar bonds rebounded and country risk eased under 750 points (Ambito). In New York YPF fell 3.10% to 47.81 and ARGT 1.03% to 81.48 (Massive).
country:argentina.was: 2026-10-23 Argentina's country risk rose to 709 points on Oct 22 and the official dollar sold at a nominal record 1,550 pesos at Banco Nacion (wholesale 1,528), while the Merval fell 1.5% to 97,993 as the tech sell off hit ADRs (Rio Times).

country:brazil.value: 2026-10-31 Week one after the election: the Ibovespa fell 18.12%, its worst week since March 2020, and the PTAX dollar rate was R$5.4212 on Oct 30 (Rio Times). In New York EWZ fell 23.78% for the week to 32.46, NU 23.4% to 11.61, ITUB 26.3% to 7.13 and BBD 37.3% to 2.55 (Massive). Polymarket gives 78.4% to a Selic hold on Nov 4; Itau cut its 2027 GDP forecast to 0.5% and raised 2027 inflation to 6.1%.
country:brazil.was: 2026-10-30 Day four of the post election slide: the Ibovespa fell 1.06% to 169,186 on Oct 29 and the dollar rose 0.76% to R$5.39 (Agencia Brasil). Correction to earlier entries: the pre election Focus survey expected a Selic cut in November, and after the vote analysts debate a pause; a hike is one view, not the consensus (Folha, Estadao). US closes Oct 29: EWZ 33.14, NU 12.05, ITUB 7.37, BBD 2.63, PBR 21.90 (Massive).

country:china.value: 2026-10-30 The CSI 300 fell 1.39% to 3,985.50 on Oct 30 as global tech sold off, while the Hang Seng rose about 1.5% late in the session (CNBC). The yuan midpoint was set at 6.7138 (TMGM).
country:china.was: 2026-10-29 The yuan rose to 6.6620 per dollar on Oct 29, a four year high, after the Fed's hold; it is up about 5% against the dollar this year and the midpoint was fixed at 6.7147 (Reuters via Economic Times).

country:europe.value: 2026-10-30 The ECB held at 2.5% on Oct 29 and said a hike was debated; markets price about a 67% chance of a December hike. Lagarde will step down Feb 7, 2027. France's Q3 GDP fell 0.1%, and December Dutch gas rose to 101.63 euros on Oct 30, the highest since late 2022 (CNBC).
country:europe.was: 2026-10-28 The euro fell to a 17 month low against the dollar on Oct 28 as the dollar hit a two week high and French fiscal concerns lingered; the exact level was not found. UBS's Q3 net profit of $2.69 billion missed the $2.71 billion consensus, and the ECB approved Intesa Sanpaolo's 31.4 billion euro takeover of Monte dei Paschi (Dow Jones via Morningstar).

country:gulf.value: 2026-10-31 Brent's December contract expired Oct 30 at $117.64 and January settled at $113.43, capping a 13.6% October (FinanceFeeds). On Oct 31 the Times of Israel carried a report that the US warned Gulf allies of possible strikes on Iran as early as Nov 4, and another that a US delegation would join direct talks in Doha after a breakthrough. Seven OPEC+ members meet online Nov 1 and were expected to hold December output (Reuters sources via FinanceFeeds).
country:gulf.was: 2026-10-30 A tanker in the Strait of Hormuz was hit by explosive devices on Oct 30, Houthi rebels claimed strikes on Saudi refineries at Ras Tanura and Rabigh and a site at Abqaiq, and Brent rose 2.4% to $117.62 (Reuters). Gulf exports are above pre war levels (Kpler via Al Jazeera). Exxon and Chevron cancelled executive trips to next week's ADIPEC show in Abu Dhabi (Reuters).

country:india.value: 2026-10-30 The Nifty rose 0.51% to 23,053.10 and the Sensex 0.42% to 74,459.53 on Oct 30, led by IT and pharma, while other Asian markets fell; Infosys rose 2.70% (Business Line, ET Now). Reserves fell a seventh straight week (Reuters).
country:india.was: 2026-10-29 The Sensex rose 905.01 points to 74,151.04 and the Nifty 1.05% to 22,936.75 on Oct 29 after the Fed held, led by banks and consumer stocks (Deccan Herald); the rupee closed at 95.25 per dollar (Economic Times). Brent easing toward $113 helps an oil importer.

country:japan.value: 2026-10-30 The BOJ held at 1.25% on Oct 30 with one dissent for a hike and said inflation is now 'generally consistent' with 2%, its first such call since 2013. The Nikkei fell 2.12% to 63,290.11 as chip equipment names sold off after Amazon and Intel (CNBC).
country:japan.was: 2026-10-29 The Nikkei rose 1.1% to 64,659.25 on Oct 29, a fourth straight gain, while Korea fell, as SoftBank and Kioxia rose (TradingKey). The dollar climbed back above 158 yen before the BOJ's Oct 30 decision, which FXStreet previews as a hawkish hold.

country:mexico.value: 2026-10-30 The peso fell 1.2% to about 18.86 per dollar on Oct 29 after strong US growth and inflation data, and Banxico's Borja defended the 6.50% rate (TMGM). Q3 GDP is due Oct 30.
country:mexico.was: 2026-10-13 The peso rebounded 0.73% to about 18.26 per dollar on Oct 12 after last week's slide to its weakest since November 2025. September inflation rose to 3.45% a year from 3.26%, a bit under the 3.47% forecast. Banxico's next decision is Nov 5 at 6.50%.

country:south-korea.value: 2026-10-30 The KOSPI fell 3.48% to 5,730.74 on Oct 30 after Amazon and Intel results, with SK hynix down about 6.4% and Samsung about 3.5% during the session (CNBC). The Roundhill Memory ETF is down 14% in October (CNBC).
country:south-korea.was: 2026-10-29 Samsung reported record Q3 operating profit of 107.44 trillion won, about in line, with chip profit of 106.5 trillion won; it said HBM is sold out for next year and chip capex rises 62%, but deferred new shareholder returns to January (CNBC, Reuters). Samsung fell 4.13%, SK hynix rose 2.22% and the KOSPI fell 1.24% to 5,937.66 (TradingKey).

country:taiwan.value: 2026-10-30 The Taiex fell 2.49% to 45,211.83 on Oct 30 after Amazon and Intel results, with a net NT$112.47 billion of foreign selling; TSMC fell 1.86% to NT$2,370 (Focus Taiwan). Trading Economics showed an intraday low near 44,922; the close from Focus Taiwan is used.
country:taiwan.was: 2026-10-29 The Taiex fell 667.25 points, or 1.42%, to 46,368.33 on Oct 29, breaking below its quarterly moving average, as UMC hit limit down after its earnings call and Alphabet's drop weighed on AI names (BigGo Finance).
